messages.subject: Rj packages
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

Great works ! I believe that all 'aficionados' of R appreciate the work done around Statet.

I try on Windows XP the integration of R (3.0) with the last version available for download.
Unfortunately  rj-1.1.3-1 is only available only for X64 architecture.
Do you plan to build a package for 32 bit ....

Many thanks for this great Statet,

Olivier J.

You use Eclipse 4.2? This is maybe the keyboard binding issue already 
discussed on the mailing list (a bug in Eclipse 4, it doesn't remove or 
disable keybindings of old plug-ins). The proposed workaround was the 
very last post at:

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/9113321/restoring-default-keybindings-in-eclipse

(remove <workspace>/.metadata/.plugins/org.eclipse.e4.workbench ,
the project settings and most other settings are kept.

Regards,
Stephan
